title: Knowledge Context Protocol Manifest
description: Schema for knowledge.yaml — a KCP manifest describing the knowledge units in a project. See https://github.com/Cantara/knowledge-context-protocol/blob/main/SPEC.md

kcp_version.description: Version of the KCP specification this manifest conforms to. RECOMMENDED. Current value: "0.30". Prior drafts "0.1" through "0.14", "0.16" through "0.28" are also accepted for backward compatibility ("0.15" was never a spec version).

project.description: Human-readable name of the project or documentation site. REQUIRED.

version.description: Semver version of this manifest. Increment when units are added or removed. RECOMMENDED.

updated.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) when this manifest was last modified. RECOMMENDED. Quote the value in YAML.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag as default for all units. OPTIONAL. Example: "en", "no", "de".

license.description: Default license for all units. OPTIONAL. Either an SPDX identifier string or a structured object.

indexing.description: Default AI crawling and indexing permissions for all units. OPTIONAL.

oneOf.description: Shorthand: open, read-only, no-train, or none.

trust.description: Publisher provenance and audit requirements for this manifest. OPTIONAL. See SPEC.md §3.2.

authority_level_scale.description: Fixed, total-ordered ordinal authority scale (v0.27). Recommended: [observe, explain, suggest, prepare, commit]. Not per-manifest extensible — grant_ceiling's minimum computation requires a shared total order across sources. See SPEC.md §3.13.

task_types.description: Task-type declarations, each an id-keyed authority_level ceiling (v0.27). See SPEC.md §3.13.

agents.description: Agent declarations (Capability Profiles), each an id-keyed authority_level ceiling (v0.27). See SPEC.md §3.13.

units.description: Ordered list of knowledge unit declarations. REQUIRED. Must contain at least one unit.

manifests.description: Federation declarations — external KCP manifests this manifest has a relationship with. OPTIONAL. See SPEC.md §3.6.

external_relationships.description: Explicit typed relationships between units across manifest boundaries. OPTIONAL. See SPEC.md §3.6.

not_for.description: Manifest-level negative-space declarations: purposes or audiences this knowledge is explicitly NOT for. OPTIONAL. See RFC-0015 (v0.17).

spdx.description: SPDX license identifier. Use LicenseRef-Proprietary for custom licenses.

url.description: URL to the full license text.

attribution_required.description: Whether the agent must cite the source when reproducing content. Default: false.

indexing_object.description: Structured AI crawling and indexing permissions.

allow.description: Operations that agents MAY perform. Values: read, index, reproduce-in-response, train, cache-permanently, share-externally, summarise.

deny.description: Operations that agents MUST NOT perform. Values: read, index, reproduce-in-response, train, cache-permanently, share-externally, summarise.

attribution_required.description: Whether reproduction requires citing the source. Default: false.

unit.description: A self-contained piece of knowledge in the manifest.

id.description: Unique identifier within this manifest. Lowercase ASCII letters (a-z), digits (0-9), hyphens (-), and dots (.) only.

aliases.description: Additional identifiers that resolve to this unit (v0.26). Each MUST match the id character rules and be unique across all ids and aliases in the manifest. See SPEC.md §4.2a.

path.description: Relative path from the manifest file's location to the content file.

kind.description: Type of artifact. Default: knowledge. Values: knowledge (documentation), schema (machine-readable definition), service (callable endpoint), policy (authoritative rules), executable (runnable artifact), skill (governed executable procedure whose selection is gated like knowledge; declares an action_scope), playbook (ordered composition of units, governed per step).  See SPEC.md §4.3a.

load_eligible.description: RFC-0028 (v0.30): the explicit eligibility grant §16.3 C4 requires. Defined only for kind: skill and kind: playbook. Absent means NOT eligible — a governed procedure fails closed and renders as a pointer. A grant, not a capability claim: it does not widen action_scope or raise authority_level.

steps.description: Ordered composition a kind: playbook declares. REQUIRED and non-empty for kind: playbook. See SPEC.md §4.3b.

uses.description: Unit id this step enacts; SHOULD name a kind: skill unit. MUST resolve to a declared unit, and MUST NOT name another playbook.

action.description: Inline description, when no unit exists yet. An inline step has no action_scope and is bounded only by its authority_level.

depends_on.description: Step ids that must complete successfully first. The graph MUST be acyclic. Absent means the preceding step in declaration order.

authority_level.description: §3.13 scale. Ceiling semantics: at most this level.

escalation.description: §3.14 trigger(s), evaluated before enactment. Disjunctive: any one firing suspends the step.

success_condition.description: Prose assertion. The protocol defines no evaluation mechanism; outcomes are confirmed | not_confirmed | not_evaluated.

on_failure.description: Default abort. 'continue' continues the run but does NOT permit dependent steps to proceed.

timeout.description: ISO 8601 duration. Elapsing constitutes failure; the clock pauses while a step is suspended awaiting a grant.

action_scope.description: The tools, paths, capabilities, and spend a procedure or skill is permitted to touch (v0.26). Advisory declaration surfaced to agents and used for conformance checking of a kind: skill unit. All sub-fields OPTIONAL. See SPEC.md §4.3a.

tools.description: Tool names the procedure may invoke.

paths.description: File-system paths (globs permitted) the procedure may read or write.

capabilities.description: Named capabilities the procedure requires or exercises.

spend.description: Purchases the procedure may make. Governs the buy decision fail-closed; where the caller maintains a cumulative session budget the effective limit is the lower of the two. That session budget is supplied at run time and is not a manifest field. All sub-fields OPTIONAL. See SPEC.md §4.3a.1.

max_spend.description: Per-purchase spend cap, in units of 'currency'. A purchase exceeding this is held.

allowed_vendors.description: Allowlist of vendor/payee identifiers the procedure may pay. A purchase to an unlisted vendor is held.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code (USD, EUR) or crypto ticker (USDC, ETH) that 'max_spend' is denominated in.

intent.description: One sentence describing the question this unit answers or the task it enables.

format.description: Content format of the referenced file. Values: markdown, pdf, openapi, json-schema, jupyter, html, asciidoc, rst, vtt, yaml, json, csv, text. Unknown values are silently ignored.

content_type.description: Full MIME type for precise format identification. Takes precedence over format when both are present.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag for this unit's content. Overrides root-level language.

scope.description: Breadth of applicability: global, project, or module.

audience.description: Who this unit is for. One or more of: human, agent, developer, architect, operator, devops.

license.description: License and usage rights for this unit. Overrides root-level license.

validated.description: ISO 8601 date when a human last confirmed the content was accurate. RECOMMENDED.

update_frequency.description: How often this content typically changes. Values: hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, rarely, never.

indexing.description: AI crawling and indexing permissions for this unit. Overrides root-level indexing.

oneOf.description: Shorthand: open, read-only, no-train, or none.

depends_on.description: IDs of units that should be loaded before this one.

supersedes.description: ID of the unit this replaces.

triggers.description: Keywords or short phrases indicating when this unit is relevant. Max 20 items, each max 60 characters.

access.description: Who can fetch this unit's content. Advisory signal. Values: public (default), authenticated, restricted. See SPEC.md §4.11.

auth_scope.description: Opaque scope token required to access this unit. Interpretation is defined by the publisher, not by KCP. Only meaningful when access is authenticated or restricted. See SPEC.md §4.11.

sensitivity.description: Information classification level. Values: public, internal, confidential, restricted. See SPEC.md §4.12.

deprecated.description: If true, this unit is present but should not be used for new development. Agents SHOULD prefer non-deprecated alternatives. See SPEC.md §4.13.

external_depends_on.description: Cross-manifest dependencies for this unit. OPTIONAL. See SPEC.md §3.6.

not_for.description: Negative-space declarations: purposes or audiences this unit is explicitly NOT for. OPTIONAL. See RFC-0015 (v0.17).

not_for_strict.description: If true, the not_for declarations are normative exclusions rather than advisory hints. Default: false. Only meaningful alongside not_for. See RFC-0015 (v0.17).

authority_level.description: Ceiling on the manifest's root authority_level_scale (v0.27). Consumable as a grant_ceiling source via unit_ref. See SPEC.md §4.23/§3.13.

content_structure_object.description: Structural description of a unit's content. All fields optional and advisory. Unknown vocabulary values SHOULD warn but MUST pass through (forward-compat). See RFC-0016 (v0.17).

primary.description: The dominant content modality. Values: prose, table, code, list, diagram, reference, mixed.

contains.description: Additional content modalities present in the unit. Values: prose, table, code, list, diagram, reference, mixed.

density.description: Information density classification. Values: sparse, normal, dense.

unit_hints.description: Advisory context window hints for a knowledge unit. All fields are optional. Unknown fields MUST be silently ignored.

token_estimate.description: Approximate token count for a typical LLM tokenizer. Advisory.

token_estimate_method.description: How the estimate was produced: measured (actual tokenizer run) or estimated (heuristic). Default: estimated.

size_bytes.description: Raw file size in bytes. Model-agnostic.

load_strategy.description: When to load this unit: eager (immediately), lazy (on demand, default), never (only if explicitly requested).

priority.description: Eviction priority when context budget is tight: critical (evict last), supplementary (default), reference (evict first).

density.description: Information-to-token ratio: dense (every sentence load-bearing), standard (default), verbose (summarisation worthwhile).

summary_available.description: A shorter summary of this unit exists in this manifest. summary_unit SHOULD be declared when true.

summary_unit.description: Unit id of the shorter summary. Required when summary_available is true.

summary_of.description: Unit id that this unit summarises. Declared on the summary side of the relationship.

partial_load_supported.description: Whether the content source supports partial or range requests. Default: false.

chunked.description: This unit has been split into sequential chunks. chunk_count SHOULD be declared alongside.

chunk_count.description: Total number of chunks this unit is split into.

chunk_of.description: Unit id of the parent this chunk belongs to.

chunk_index.description: 1-based position of this chunk within the parent sequence.

total_chunks.description: Total chunks in the parent. Mirrors chunk_count on the parent.

chunk_topic.description: Short phrase describing what this chunk covers.

root_hints.description: Manifest-level aggregate context hints. All fields are advisory. Unknown fields MUST be silently ignored.

total_token_estimate.description: Advisory sum of all unit token_estimate values. Should be recomputed by tooling, not maintained by hand.

unit_count.description: Total number of units declared in this manifest.

recommended_entry_point.description: Unit id the publisher recommends loading first.

has_summaries.description: At least one unit in this manifest has summary_available: true.

has_chunks.description: At least one unit in this manifest has chunked: true.

trust_provenance.description: Publisher identity fields within the trust block. All fields are optional and advisory. See SPEC.md §3.2.

publisher.description: Human-readable name of the publishing organisation or individual.

publisher_url.description: URL of the publisher's web presence. MUST use HTTPS if present.

contact.description: Email address or URL for questions about this manifest's content.

publisher_did.description: A W3C Decentralized Identifier for the publisher (e.g. did:web:acme.com). Advisory; cryptographically resolvable identity (v0.23).

trust_audit.description: Audit requirements within the trust block. All fields are optional and advisory. See SPEC.md §3.2.

agent_must_log.description: Whether agents SHOULD log every access to this manifest's units. Default: false.

require_trace_context.description: Whether agents SHOULD attach W3C Trace Context (traceparent/tracestate) headers when fetching unit content. For local file access, agents SHOULD generate a traceparent value and record it in local logs. Default: false.

provides_access_receipts.description: Whether the source issues a verifiable receipt for each access, so an auditor can confirm which agent accessed which unit and when. A capability of the source, not a requirement on the agent (v0.23). Default: false.

receipt_format.description: Identifies the receipt format when provides_access_receipts is true — e.g. jws, vc (W3C Verifiable Credential), or a URL to a format spec (v0.23).

trust_agent_requirements.description: Agent attestation requirements within the trust block (v0.22). Declares what an agent must prove about itself before access: restricted units are served. KCP declares; agents attest. See SPEC.md §3.2.

require_attestation.description: If true, agents MUST present attestation before accessing access: restricted units. Satisfied by trusted_providers OR attestation_url. Default: false.

trusted_providers.description: Trusted agent-provider domain names (identity-based; matched against the OIDC-A agent_provider claim).

attestation_url.description: HTTPS endpoint that verifies agent credentials (credential-based). The verification mechanism is out of KCP scope.

attestation_jwks.description: JWKS endpoint URL for verifying signed responses from attestation_url. If absent, agents use the attestation_url TLS certificate as trust anchor.

propagate_to_governed.description: If true, a manifest that governs another declares that its governed manifests MUST satisfy at least these attestation requirements. Default: false.

auth_object.description: Root-level authentication methods available for accessing protected units. OPTIONAL. See SPEC.md §3.3.

methods.description: Ordered list of authentication methods supported by the publisher. Agents pick the first method they can satisfy.

auth_method.description: A single authentication method declaration. The type field determines which sub-fields are relevant.

type.description: Authentication method type. Defined values (v0.22): none, oauth2, api_key, bearer_token, spiffe, did, http_signature. Units with access: authenticated or access: restricted require a non-none method. Unknown types are silently ignored.

issuer.description: OAuth 2.1 issuer URL. Required when type is oauth2.

scopes.description: OAuth 2.1 scopes available. Relevant when type is oauth2.

header.description: HTTP header name for the API key. Default: X-API-Key. Relevant when type is api_key.

registration_url.description: URL where agents or users can obtain credentials.

trust_domain.description: SPIFFE trust domain the source accepts. Relevant when type is spiffe (v0.22).

supported_methods.description: Accepted DID methods (e.g. did:web, did:key). Relevant when type is did (v0.22).

key_id.description: Identifier of the key the agent signs with. Relevant when type is http_signature (v0.22).

algorithm.description: Signature algorithm (e.g. ed25519). Relevant when type is http_signature (v0.22).

delegation_object.description: Delegation chain constraints for multi-agent access. Can appear at root level (as default for all units) or at unit level (as override). See SPEC.md §3.4.

max_depth.description: Maximum delegation chain depth. 0 = no delegation permitted. Omit for no constraint.

require_capability_attenuation.description: If true, each hop in the delegation chain MUST present narrower permissions than the delegating agent held.

require_delegation_proof.description: If true, an accessing agent MUST present a verifiable delegation chain back to the resource owner, not merely assert a depth. Parsers expose it; proof verification is the agent's (v0.23). Default: false.

audit_chain.description: If true, agents MUST include W3C Trace Context headers on all access requests.

required.description: If true, a human MUST approve agent access before the unit may be loaded. Default: false.

approval_mechanism.description: How human approval is obtained. Values: oauth_consent, uma, custom.

docs_url.description: URL describing the approval flow. REQUIRED when approval_mechanism is custom.

compliance_object.description: Compliance classification and processing restrictions. Can appear at root level (as default for all units) or at unit level (as override). See SPEC.md §3.5.

data_residency.description: Permitted geographic regions for data storage and processing. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes or region identifiers (e.g. EEA, US, CH).

sensitivity.description: Information sensitivity level. Values: public, internal, confidential, restricted.

regulations.description: Named regulations that apply to this knowledge. Unknown values MUST be silently ignored.

restrictions.description: Processing restrictions. Unknown values MUST be silently ignored.

payment_object.description: Monetisation model. Can appear at root level (as default for all units) or at unit level (as override; replaces root, no merge). Advisory — KCP declares economics and settles nothing. See SPEC.md §4.14.

default_tier.description: Monetisation tier. Values: free (default), metered (per-request billing), subscription (requires active plan).

methods.description: Ordered list of accepted payment methods (v0.25). Ordered by publisher preference; an agent SHOULD select the first it supports.

billing_contact.description: Contact (email or URL) for billing questions (v0.25).

payment_method.description: One accepted payment mechanism (v0.25). See SPEC.md §4.14.

type.description: Payment mechanism. free (no cost), x402 (HTTP 402 micropayment), meter (metered API billing), subscription (plan-based).

currency.description: x402: ISO 4217 code (USD, EUR) or crypto ticker (USDC, ETH). Required for x402.

price_per_request.description: x402: amount as a decimal string (e.g. "0.001") to avoid floating-point rounding. Required for x402.

networks.description: x402: settlement networks accepted (ethereum, base, solana, polygon).

wallet.description: x402: receiving wallet address or payment-processor endpoint URL. KCP never dereferences it.

provider.description: meter: billing provider, e.g. stripe, google-ap2, generic.

plans_url.description: meter / subscription: URL describing plans or pricing.

free_tier.description: subscription: whether a free tier exists under the plan.

free_requests_per_day.description: subscription: free-tier request budget per day.

upgrade_url.description: subscription: URL to upgrade from the free tier.

rate_limit_count.description: A request/token count limit: a positive integer, or the sentinel "unlimited" (v0.25).

rate_limit_tier.description: Rate limits for one authentication tier. See SPEC.md §4.15.

rate_limit_tokens_tier.description: Token-based limits for one authentication tier (v0.25).

rate_limits_object.description: Rate limit declarations. Can appear at root level (as default for all units) or at unit level (as override). Advisory — agents self-throttle, KCP does not enforce. See SPEC.md §4.15.

authenticated.description: Limits for an authenticated non-premium agent (v0.25).

tokens.description: Token-based limits mirroring the tier structure (v0.25).

headers.description: Names of response headers carrying live limit state (v0.25).

serving_object.description: Signed declaration of the manifest's authoritative serving endpoints (v0.26). Each declared list is exhaustive for its class; every entry MUST be HTTPS. See SPEC.md §3.12.

manifest.description: HTTPS URLs at which this manifest is authoritatively served. A verifier that retrieved it from an unlisted URL demotes trusted -> known (C22).

mcp.description: HTTPS URLs of MCP endpoints authorized to represent this manifest to agents.

task_type.description: A task-type declaration with its own authority_level ceiling (v0.27). See SPEC.md §3.13.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the manifest.

intent.description: One-sentence description of the task-type, in the style of unit intent.

authority_level.description: This task-type's own declared ceiling, from the root authority_level_scale.

agent.description: An agent declaration (Capability Profile) with its own authority_level ceiling (v0.27). See SPEC.md §3.13.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the manifest.

authority_level.description: This agent's own capability ceiling, across all tasks it is assigned, from the root authority_level_scale.

grant_ceiling_source.description: One ceiling source in a grant_ceiling minimum computation. Exactly one of authority_level, unit_ref, task_type_ref, agent_ref MUST be present. See SPEC.md §3.13.

id.description: Stable identifier for this source, used in the effective-level trace and in mandatory_sources.

authority_level.description: Inline ceiling value from authority_level_scale. Mutually exclusive with the *_ref fields.

unit_ref.description: Resolve ceiling from a referenced unit's own authority_level.

task_type_ref.description: Resolve ceiling from a referenced task_types[].id's own authority_level.

agent_ref.description: Resolve ceiling from a referenced agents[].id's own declared capability ceiling.

grant_ceiling_object.description: Multi-source minimum ceiling computation: the effective authority_level is the minimum across all resolved sources, with the binding source(s) named for the audit trail (v0.27). See SPEC.md §3.13.

sources.description: Ceiling sources. Every id declared in mandatory_sources MUST appear here.

mandatory_sources.description: Source ids that MUST appear in every grant_ceiling in this manifest. A grant_ceiling missing one is a manifest error — this prevents a leaf from silently dropping an org policy ceiling.

relationship.description: An explicit directional relationship between two knowledge units.

type.description: The type of relationship. Defined values: enables, context, supersedes, contradicts, depends_on, governs.

manifest_ref.description: A reference to an external KCP manifest in the federation. See SPEC.md §3.6.

id.description: Local identifier for this sub-manifest. MUST be unique within the manifests block.

url.description: HTTPS URL of the remote knowledge.yaml. MUST use HTTPS.

relationship.description: How this sub-manifest relates to the declaring manifest. Values: child, foundation, governs, peer, archive.

update_frequency.description: How often this remote manifest typically changes. Agents MAY use this for cache freshness decisions.

local_mirror.description: Relative path (forward slashes) to a local copy of the remote manifest. When present and the file exists, parsers MUST load from that path instead of fetching url.

version_pin.description: Semver version to pin this sub-manifest to. Validators SHOULD compare against the remote manifest's version field. See SPEC.md §3.6.

version_policy.description: How to interpret version_pin. Default: compatible. See SPEC.md §3.6.

context.description: Environment labels for which this sub-manifest reference is valid (v0.24). Absent = valid in all environments. Non-normative vocabulary: dev, test, staging, prod. Advisory selection hint. See SPEC.md §3.6.

agent_identity.description: Pre-fetch credential-planning hint on a manifests[] entry (v0.24). Declaration layer, not an auth protocol. See SPEC.md §3.6.

required.description: Whether a credential is expected before fetching this sub-manifest. Default: false.

credential_hint.description: Advisory credential type. Non-normative vocabulary: github_pat, oauth2, confluence_pat, api_key, none. Implementations MAY extend.

issuer_hint.description: For oauth2: the issuer URL the agent should use to obtain a token.

docs_url.description: Where a developer finds instructions for acquiring the credential.

external_dependency.description: A cross-manifest dependency for a knowledge unit. See SPEC.md §3.6.

manifest.description: The id of an entry in this manifest's manifests block.

unit.description: The id of a unit in the referenced manifest.

on_failure.description: Agent behaviour when the external unit cannot be resolved. Default: skip.

external_relationship.description: An explicit typed relationship between units across manifest boundaries. See SPEC.md §3.6.

from_manifest.description: Source manifest id. Omit for this manifest.

to_manifest.description: Target manifest id. Omit for this manifest.

type.description: Relationship type. Same vocabulary as §5: enables, context, supersedes, contradicts, depends_on, governs.

visibility_object.description: Conditional access declarations. Can appear at root level (as manifest-wide default) or at unit level (as override). See SPEC.md §4.16 and RFC-0009.

default.description: Baseline sensitivity when no condition matches. Values: public, internal, confidential, restricted.

conditions.description: Ordered list of condition objects. First matching condition wins.

when.description: Matching criteria. A condition matches when ALL when keys match the agent's declared context.

environment.description: Match when the agent's environment equals this value or appears in this list.

agent_role.description: Match when the agent's declared role equals this value or appears in this list.

then.description: Overrides to apply when this condition matches.

sensitivity.description: Sensitivity override. Values: public, internal, confidential, restricted.

requires_auth.description: Whether authentication is required to access this unit under this condition.

authority_object.description: Action permission declarations. Can appear at root level (as manifest-wide default) or at unit level (as override). See SPEC.md §4.17 and RFC-0009.

read.description: Permission to load and reason over this unit's content. Default: initiative.

summarize.description: Permission to produce summaries or extracts of this unit. Default: initiative.

modify.description: Permission to modify files, records, or code described by or in this unit. Default: denied.

share_externally.description: Permission to include this content in external communications or outputs sent outside the agent's working context. Default: denied.

execute.description: Permission to run commands, scripts, or instructions contained in this unit. Default: denied.

discovery_object.description: Provenance metadata for how a unit was discovered. Can appear at root level (as manifest-wide default) or at unit level. See SPEC.md §4.18 and RFC-0012.

verification_status.description: The current verification state of this capability declaration. Values: rumored, declared, observed, verified, deprecated. Default (when absent): verified.

source.description: How this unit was discovered. Values: manual, web_traversal, openapi, llm_inference, manifest-self-description. Default: manual.

observed_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this capability was first observed or inferred.

verified_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this capability was independently confirmed. MUST be null if verification_status is rumored, declared, or observed.

confidence.description: Confidence in this capability declaration. Range 0.0–1.0. Rumored units MUST have confidence < 0.5. Declared units SHOULD have confidence in [0.5, 0.8). Verified units SHOULD have confidence >= 0.8.

contradicted_by.description: The id of another unit in this manifest that provides a conflicting description of the same capability.
